item.title: Common Misconceptions about IP Addresses
item.description: It’s a common misconception that if someone gets your IP address they can find your real home address, get your exact location, hack all your passwords, etc. None of this is true and the only real threat is something like a DDoS attack (Not the same as being doxxed). They can usually also see your general location like City or Neighborhood depending on where you are, you can see what your IP says about you on a site like this if you’re worried about it.
